Location: Sylhet, Bangladesh (UTC+6) Remote: Yes Willing to relocate: Yes, with visa sponsorship. Netherlands, Germany, Japan, Ireland, UAE, Singapore Technologies: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, AWS (ECS, S3, CodePipeline, CodeDeploy), Docker, OpenAI and Gemini APIs, MCP, Python Résumé/CV: https://linkedin.com/in/marufhpulok GitHub: https://github.com/MarufPulok Email: dev.mhpulok@gmail.com

Full-stack engineer, 4 years, currently senior engineer and team lead at a US SaaS startup. Things I built there: an AI tenant-screening feature (LLM tool calling over MCP, streamed chat with vector-search memory), an AWS deploy pipeline where a 10% canary rolls back by itself on 5xx or latency alarms, and resumable 100GB+ uploads that go straight to S3.

On the side I turned an old laptop into a self-hosted AI assistant with local models and phone alerts, and sent a fix upstream to Odysseus along the way: https://github.com/MarufPulok/odysseus-homelab

Looking for full-stack or backend roles on a product team. Also open to fixed-price contract work right now: small automations (scraping, email/Slack triage, LLM extraction, scheduled jobs) delivered in about a week.
